commentary: Weinstein and O'Neil teach that three of four equities mirror the general market trend. With our market gate flagged as WEAK and market breadth subdued at 40, isolated relief rallies cannot replace broad institutional accumulation. Legendary discipline dictates a defensive posture: preserve capital, avoid chasing extended setups, and enforce rapid loss-cutting. In weak breadth regimes, breakouts experience elevated failure rates. Exposure must remain progressive and restricted only to verified Stage 2 candidates backed by accelerating CANSLIM-grade fundamentals and clear volume accumulation, while waiting for the broader indices to deliver a confirmed follow-through day before scaling risk.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above short and medium moving averages near 104.09 with 1.23x volume, but lacks genuine VCP tightening or decisive relative strength.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction with Q1 FY27 revenue dropping 56.3% YoY and profit declining 25.6%. Return on equity is weak (~3.1%), failing CANSLIM standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below 95.68 violates structural support; negative fundamental trend warrants complete capital protection.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Holding cleanly above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA within 1.5% of 933.53 pivot on 2.31x volume expansion; RSI 54.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Strong operational traction driven by Xanthine derivative demand and CDMO scale-up, boosting Q1 revenue 38.7% and PAT 53.8% YoY. ₹149 crore capex supports capacity.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A drop below 857.38 breaches dynamic moving average support, invalidating the pivot and triggering an immediate exit.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of 464.91 pivot above key 21, 50, and 200 averages. Above-average volume (1.37x) and RSI 72 indicate strong momentum.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Outstanding Q1 FY27 print with net profit surging 79.9% YoY and revenues jumping 63.3%, propelled by aggressive BESS commissioning. High leverage partially mitigated by QIP.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Violation of 425.12 invalidates the pivot structure; capital intensity demands strict adherence to stop boundaries.

AEGISLOG.technical: Double-bottom breakout setup near 1501.7 backed by massive 2.43x volume. Bullish moving average alignment and strong MACD confirm true leadership relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM credentials with Q1 FY27 net profit surging 212% YoY and sales expanding 37%, driven by record LPG throughput and port logistics scale.
AEGISLOG.risk: A close below 1358.19 compromises double-bottom integrity and rising moving averages, triggering an immediate loss cut.

AGI.technical: Cleared 20-day high at 824.82 on 2x average volume, maintaining position above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with constructive RSI 60.
AGI.fundamental: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 14.2% and PAT grew 11.8% on alcobev demand, but growth decelerated from Q4 FY26 (+19.4%), missing CANSLIM 25% profit benchmarks.
AGI.risk: A fall beneath 752.56 violates the breakout shelf; decelerating bottom-line growth allows zero tolerance for holding losers.

AHCL.technical: SEPA breakout to new 52-week highs clearing 27.51 on 1.78x volume, comfortably stationed above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA.
AHCL.fundamental: Hyper-growth quarter with sales up 163% YoY and net profit expanding 88% in Q1 FY27, catalyzed by recent API acquisitions and ~20.8% ROCE.
AHCL.risk: Breaching 23.93 invalidates the breakout base; higher volatility in micro-caps necessitates strict stop-loss adherence.
